hardware: NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop GPU using CatBoost GPU training

cpu.decision: Provisional candidate only. Corrected baseline comparison shows about 0.21% lower MAE and better RMSE/R2, but absolute predictive performance remains weak.

memory.decision: Provisional candidate only. MAE is about 0.19% worse than the corrected baseline, although RMSE and R2 improve slightly; meaningful predictive improvement is not established.

power.decision: Retain as a candidate for absolute PDU-time power estimation. It substantially beats the corrected PDU-specific mean baseline, but the test set is small and temporal change tracking is not validated.

log_target_experiments.cpu: Did not improve held-out test MAE over the original model.
log_target_experiments.memory: Only marginally improved held-out test MAE; no meaningful gain established.

power_temporal_evaluation.decision: Model performs worse than the no-change baseline for power-change prediction.

inference_validation.machine_time_cpu_memory: Passed current functional and input-validation tests.
inference_validation.pdu_time_power: Passed synthetic and real-data interface tests.
inference_validation.artifact_loading: All five local model artifacts loaded and matched expected feature counts.

limitations: CPU and memory predictive performance is weak.
Power test set contains only 85 PDU-time observations.
Only 17 held-out timestamps are available per PDU.
Functional inference tests do not establish predictive accuracy.
No validated waste score, root-cause analysis, or savings estimate is implemented in this phase.

remaining: Review and approve the documented model-selection decisions.
Run final regression and repository checks.
Commit and push the approved Phase 5 report and validation files.
